items.title: Henry Johnson interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] One guy said it like this, he said the only difference between Gospel and rhythm & blues is one guy is talking about God and the other guy’s talking about his girlfriend.

ctx.x: Well I think it is because the Gospel music is so closely linked with the blues. You know they talk about the same thing — give me a break. You know I mean how much blues can I take, how much, you know torment can I take, give me a break somebody. So in the Gospel music it’s give me a break, God, you know? And in the blues, give me a break period, somebody, you know?
One guy said it like this, he said the only difference between Gospel and rhythm & blues is one guy is talking about God and the other guy’s talking about his girlfriend.
